import re

items = [
    "AB-1234",     # valid
    "ab-1234",     # invalid: lowercase letters
    "ZZ-0007",     # valid
    "A1-2345",     # invalid: second char is a digit
    "QA-9999",     # valid
    "AB-12345",    # invalid: 5 digits
    "AB-123",      # invalid: 3 digits
    " AB-1234",    # invalid: leading space
    "AB1234",      # invalid: missing hyphen
]

# Compiled once at module level, fully anchored, no nested quantifiers.
# \Z (not $) so a trailing newline does not slip through.
CODE = re.compile(r"[A-Z]{2}-[0-9]{4}\Z")


def extract_valid_codes(items):
    return [s for s in items if CODE.match(s)]


print(extract_valid_codes(items))
